decisions.rationale: Gliding crow seen from above and behind with both wings fully spread and fingered primaries; the flattest, most complete wing outline of the three.

Crow in flight, wings spread, with Fly, Glide and TakeOff clips (Azure concept c, TRELLIS c-s6112). Cooked with cook_crow.py: a distance-weighted rig, 256 px textures, 86,812 bytes. Clip strips reviewed frame by frame (anim-review2).
limitations: Wing beats bend the whole wing as one surface; no primary feather separation.
TRELLIS-derived: research and evaluation licence terms, no commercial clearance.

decisions.rationale: Presentation-only crow flocks on stubble fields, chapels, gibbets and the Echo Well: they peck and perch, take off when the hero comes within 10 m, fly off and land again once the hero is 34 m away; perched and flight models swap at take-off and landing. Never in snapshots, saves or rules.
limitations: At 18-40 m a crow is 10-20 px; it reads as a black bird, not a detailed one.
